parsed.notes:
Minimum Qualifications sets required; Preferred Qualifications sets nice_to_have.
Interpreted retrieval pipelines as RAG; context pipelines may mean context engineering and is flagged for review.
OpenTelemetry and MCP are examples for a single open-source-contribution ask and are grouped as alternatives. Agents and observability are independently requested elsewhere and remain outside that group.
Unmapped entries are explicitly named technical practices without a clear taxonomy match; evaluation subpractices are retained literally rather than silently discarded.
SRE and incident management are presented as domain knowledge and are excluded. Telemetry, logs, and time-series databases describe input data rather than separately requested tools.
Design reviews and technical documentation are treated literally as technical practices, not as the surrounding communication or mentoring soft skills.
No German-language or degree requirement is stated.
